notes.title: We have sold 4,900 units! Regarding further updates on the Switch version.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/bab12769424e5955d2dfac077c0d7e623b9a0053.jpg[/img]
1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here!' has surpassed 4,900 units sold! It's been three years since its release, and we are very happy that it has grown into a title loved by everyone. 
Thank you for loving this game!
We are planning a major update for Ars Memento's Grim Reaper backstory within this year. Additionally, further updates on the Switch version will be delivered soon!

notes.title: We're working on the update right now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/113bbbe9caea7db1a62ce68e3d5112abd682747c.png[/img]
We had actually planned to update this game in time for the STEAM Winter Sale, but due to unexpected bug problems, the fix is long overdue!
This game will be updated in two parts.

1. 100 consecutive calls, and a new story.
Vanitas will try to master his craft by making 100 consecutive calls! And the more calls he clears, the more new stories will be released.
2. The story of each character's past.
The story of each character's past will revolve around the reaper days of Ars and Memento.

First, 100 consecutive calls are scheduled to be updated. We would like to update it by the end of 2022 as much as possible, but will we be able to do it in time...!

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: We are postponing the release of the Nintendo Switch version to November 2022.
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/113bbbe9caea7db1a62ce68e3d5112abd682747c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/fb796a6055348ec6fe9690e8c00c2a4bafbde9df.png[/img][/url]
Thank you for your continued support!
Due to the director's medical treatment and the impact of the coronavirus on our members, we are postponing the release of the Switch version of "1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here!" from August 2022 to [b]November 2022. [/b]
We are very sorry for those who have been waiting.
All members are recovering. The director's treatment is now strong enough to draw pictures, and he says it will not affect the development too much.
We hope to improve the quality of the game to make up for the postponement!

notes.title: Notice of Update Delay
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/0d146d40d410ad9a814b17e8b713a5d0bf377dd2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/bbb3104f2c0e6ed3ea2f92a0ab774ea58698a146.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for playing our games!
All updates were scheduled to be finished at the end of August, but
1f y0u're a gh0st ca11 me here! Due to the health problems of the core team members, we are postponing the end of the updates to the end of October.

Due to the above, the Nintendo switch version is also expected to be delayed to November.
Our team members are under threat of coronavirus. Please take care of yourselves, everyone.

notes.title: The new update will start in March 2022!
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay in the update
Director's disease treatment has been affected by the medical crunch caused by the coronavirus outbreak
Director's illness is worsening and we have decided to forgo this month's update.
We will focus on treating her illness for the next month

In the meantime, our team members will be working on new projects and preparing updates for this title.
I hope to be back in the studio in good health

Furoshiki Lab. Head Directer 
Dendaira Kotaro
